responsibility: Implements tree-level dead code elimination on GIMPLE SSA, including both basic DCE and control-dependence-aware aggressive DCE. It marks obviously necessary statements, propagates necessity through SSA uses and control dependencies, removes dead statements and PHIs, updates CFG and dominance information when branches become dead, and also provides a lightweight simple_dce_from_worklist helper for clients that already know a set of potentially dead SSA defs.
same_name_distinction: This is the full dead-code-elimination implementation and pass file, including basic DCE, aggressive control-dependence-aware DCE, CFG updates, and pass registration. By contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-dce.h only exports the small simple_dce_from_worklist helper for localized cleanup by other passes.
